questions.text: 你是教練，球隊連續 3 場輸球。隊長說「繼續用老戰術，穩一點」，但你發現對手已完全研究透你們。你會？
questions.textEn: You are the coach. The team lost 3 consecutive games. The captain says 'Stick to old tactics, play safe', but you find opponents have thoroughly researched you. What will you do?
questions.prompt: 提示：改變的勇氣，客觀事實顯示舊方法已失效。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Courage to change. Objective facts show old methods are no longer effective.
choices: A. 換新戰術，同時向隊員說明為什麼現在必須改變
B. 再觀察一場，看老戰術還有沒有機會
C. 換戰術但不解釋，直接要求隊員執行
D. 尊重隊長意見，穩定優先
choicesEn: A. Switch tactics and explain to players why change is necessary now
B. Observe one more game to see if old tactics still have a chance
C. Change tactics without explanation, demand execution
D. Respect the captain's opinion, prioritize stability
questions.explanation: 最佳解必須同時解決「戰術錯誤」與「團隊心態」。主動說明「為什麼必須改變」，能化解團隊疑慮並降低反彈阻力。
questions.explanationEn: The best solution resolves both tactical errors and team mindset. Explaining why change is necessary dispels team doubts and reduces resistance.

questions.text: 你聽說有套 AI 分析系統可預測對手跑位，但球隊從沒用過這類工具。你是總監，你會？
questions.textEn: You heard about an AI system that predicts opponent positions, but the team has never used such tools. As director, what will you do?
questions.prompt: 提示：導入新工具，需兼顧創新與風險最小化。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Introducing new tools requires balancing innovation with minimizing risk.
choices: A. 等其他球隊都用了再跟進
B. 直接全隊導入，要做就做徹底
C. 先小規模試用在一場友誼賽，驗證後再決定全面導入
D. 先請外部顧問評估半年再決定
choicesEn: A. Wait until other teams use it before following
B. Immediately roll out to the whole team thoroughly
C. Test small-scale in a friendly match first, then decide full adoption
D. Hire external consultants to evaluate for half a year first
questions.explanation: 透過小規模的「概念驗證 (PoC)」，能有效評估系統準確度，避免「大爆炸式」全面導入可能造成的營運災難與反彈。
questions.explanationEn: A small-scale Proof of Concept (PoC) effectively evaluates system accuracy and avoids big-bang rollout risks.

questions.text: 新加入的年輕球員提出從沒人用的進攻套路，資深隊員覺得「太冒險」。你是隊長，你會？
questions.textEn: A newly joined young player proposes an offensive routine no one has used, but senior players feel it is too risky. As captain, what will you do?
questions.prompt: 提示：支持新想法，需要提供安全的驗證環境。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Supporting new ideas requires providing a safe testing environment.
choices: A. 在練習中安排時間讓他實際演練，讓大家看到可能性
B. 支持他的想法，但告訴他等時機成熟再提
C. 尊重多數資深隊員意見，暫時不採用
D. 讓教練來決定，自己不表態
choicesEn: A. Schedule practice time for him to demonstrate, showing possibilities to all
B. Support his idea, but tell him to propose when the time is right
C. Respect the majority opinion of senior players, refrain for now
D. Let the coach decide without stating your own stance
questions.explanation: 提供容錯率高的測試環境（沙盒驗證），用實際演練的「結果」來打破經驗偏見，是建立團隊創新文化的最佳方法。
questions.explanationEn: Providing a fault-tolerant testing environment (sandbox) to break experience bias with actual results is the best way to foster innovation.

questions.text: 上半場結束，落後 2 球，賽前策略完全被對方破解。中場休息只有 15 分鐘，你會？
questions.textEn: First half ended down 2 goals; pre-game strategy was completely cracked by opponents. Halftime is only 15 minutes. What will you do?
questions.prompt: 提示：快速調整，資源與時間極度有限。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Rapid adjustment under extreme time and resource constraints.
choices: A. 整套策略重來，全部換掉
B. 找出對方破解我們的關鍵點，針對性調整一個環節
C. 繼續執行原本策略，下半場看隊員發揮
D. 專注鼓勵隊員士氣，策略次之
choicesEn: A. Scrape the entire strategy and replace everything
B. Identify the key point cracked and adjust one specific link targetedly
C. Continue original strategy and see how players perform in 2nd half
D. Focus solely on encouraging player morale, strategy secondary
questions.explanation: 在極短時間內，最有效的方式是進行根本原因分析，找出導致失血最嚴重的「關鍵點」進行針對性微調，避免超出團隊的執行負荷。
questions.explanationEn: In limited time, root cause analysis to fix the single most critical bottleneck is most effective.

questions.text: 新陣型需要前中後衛高度默契，但三組各自訓練，配合一直出問題。根本原因最可能是？
questions.textEn: The new formation requires high coordination among defenders and midfielders, but 3 groups train separately and teamwork keeps failing. What is the root cause?
questions.prompt: 提示：跨組協作的最大挑戰通常在於認知落差。
questions.promptEn: Hint: The biggest challenge in cross-team collaboration is cognitive gap.
choices: A. 練習場次不夠多
B. 球員個人技術還不夠好
C. 陣型本身設計有問題
D. 三組人對這個陣型要達成的目標理解不一樣
choicesEn: A. Not enough practice sessions
B. Individual technical skills are not good enough
C. The formation design itself is flawed
D. The 3 groups have different understandings of the target goals
questions.explanation: 各自為政會產生「穀倉效應」。如果各組對戰略目標沒有共識（認知落差），系統或流程交接點就容易失靈。
questions.explanationEn: Silo mentality creates gaps. If groups lack consensus on strategic goals (cognitive gap), handoffs fail.

questions.text: 今年冠軍隊靠全新打法稱霸，所有球隊開始模仿。助理教練建議你們跟進，你會？
questions.textEn: This year's champion dominated with a brand-new playstyle. All teams copy them. The assistant coach suggests following suit. What will you do?
questions.prompt: 提示：學習與模仿，不能只是盲目複製貼上。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Benchmarking and learning shouldn't be blind copy-pasting.
choices: A. 研究這套打法的邏輯，評估是否符合我們球員特性再決定
B. 立刻跟進，冠軍的方法不會錯
C. 不跟，我們要走自己的路
D. 等其他球隊試過結果再說
choicesEn: A. Study the underlying logic and evaluate fit with team characteristics first
B. Follow immediately; champion methods can't be wrong
C. Refuse to follow; we must walk our own path
D. Wait to see results from other teams first
questions.explanation: 標竿學習必須先拆解底層邏輯，並嚴謹盤點自身環境與資源的適配性，確認匹配後再進行內化與微調。
questions.explanationEn: Benchmarking requires deconstructing core logic and assessing alignment with your own resources before adoption.

questions.text: 新訓練科技效果驚人但只有少數球隊試過，賽季還有 6 週，你會？
questions.textEn: A new training tech has amazing results but only few teams tried it. Season has 6 weeks left. What will you do?
questions.prompt: 提示：押注新科技，需兼顧營運穩定與技術驗證。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Betting on new tech requires balancing operational stability and validation.
choices: A. 全隊立刻導入，搶先機
B. 等賽季結束再評估，現在不能冒險
C. 讓 2-3 名球員試用，6 週後根據數據決定是否全隊導入
D. 效果太好可能有問題，先不碰
choicesEn: A. Roll out to entire team immediately to seize first-mover advantage
B. Evaluate after season ends; can't take risks now
C. Have 2-3 players test it, then decide based on data after 6 weeks
D. Too good to be true, don't touch it
questions.explanation: 在關鍵營運衝刺期，採取先導測試並根據「客觀數據」決策，能有效將風險限縮，並在擁抱創新與維持穩定間取得平衡。
questions.explanationEn: During sprint periods, pilot testing and data-driven decisions isolate risks while embracing innovation.

questions.text: 球團給了你一筆預算要讓球隊「全面創新升級」，你第一步？
questions.textEn: The club gave you a budget for comprehensive team upgrade and innovation. What is your first step?
questions.prompt: 提示：資源分配，符合木桶理論的核心概念。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Resource allocation follows the core concept of the Bucket Theory.
choices: A. 全面同步升級，不能有短板
B. 找出最影響勝敗的弱點，從那裡開始
C. 強化已最強的環節，擴大領先優勢
D. 參考業界最新趨勢往那個方向走
choicesEn: A. Upgrade everything simultaneously, no short boards allowed
B. Identify the weakness affecting win/loss most and start there
C. Strengthen what is already strongest to expand the lead
D. Follow the latest industry trends
questions.explanation: 整體表現往往受限於最弱的一環。精準投入資源解決「最致命的瓶頸」，能帶來最高且最立竿見影的投資報酬率 (ROI)。
questions.explanationEn: Overall performance is limited by the weakest link. Resolving the vital bottleneck delivers highest ROI.

questions.text: 【混沌文字獸】主管丟給你 50 頁的會議逐字稿，要你 1 小時內整理成 5 點摘要 + 行動清單。該用哪一種 AI 能力來解決？
questions.textEn: [Chaos Text Beast] Manager gives you a 50-page transcript and asks for 5-point summary + action list in 1 hour. Which AI capability to use?
questions.prompt: 提示：50 頁逐字稿塞滿雜訊，你需要有明確格式的濃縮報告。
questions.promptEn: Hint: 50-page transcript full of noise; you need a clear structured format.
choices: A. 報告/信件草稿
B. 問答對話
C. 結構化摘要
D. 生成圖像
choicesEn: A. Report/Email Draft
B. Q&A Chat
C. Structured Summary
D. Image Generation
questions.explanation: 生成式 AI 的強大之處在於處理海量文本。使用「結構化摘要」能強迫 AI 將抓取到的重點，精準填入指定的框架格式中。
questions.explanationEn: Generative AI excels at handling large text. Structured summary forces AI into your specified template.

questions.text: 【多步驟迷宮獸】老闆要你研究 10 家競品、上他們官網抓價格、整理成比較表，並且每週自動更新。該用哪一種 AI 能力來解決？
questions.textEn: [Multi-step Labyrinth Beast] Boss wants you to research 10 competitors, fetch prices from websites, format comparison table, auto-update weekly. Which AI capability?
questions.prompt: 提示：任務包含定義目標、爬蟲、清理資料與排程。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Mission includes defining goals, web scraping, data cleaning, and scheduling.
choices: A. 規劃執行 (AI Agent)
B. 結構化摘要
C. 引用回答 (RAG)
D. 問答對話
choicesEn: A. Planning & Execution (AI Agent)
B. Structured Summary
C. Cited Answers (RAG)
D. Q&A Chat
questions.explanation: AI Agent 具備「任務拆解規劃」與「調用外部工具」的能力，能處理這類多步驟且需自主執行的複雜自動化任務。
questions.explanationEn: AI Agents possess task decomposition and tool orchestration capabilities for multi-step automated tasks.

questions.text: 【重複勞動獸】你每週要手動把表單資料複製到 Excel，再寄 Email 通知給三個人，重複做 50 次。該用哪一種 AI 能力？
questions.textEn: [Repetitive Labor Beast] Every week you manually copy form data into Excel and email 3 people, repeating 50 times. Which AI capability?
questions.prompt: 提示：打破不同軟體之間的資訊孤島。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Break down information silos between different software.
choices: A. 系統串接
B. 自主瀏覽
C. 結搆化摘要
D. 問答對話
choicesEn: A. System Integration
B. Autonomous Browsing
C. Structured Summary
D. Q&A Chat
questions.explanation: 透過系統串接（如 API 連接器），能讓彼此獨立的平台自動化交換數據，徹底消除人工複製貼上的低價值重複勞動。
questions.explanationEn: System integration (like API connectors) allows independent platforms to automatically exchange data.

questions.text: 【幻覺資訊獸】客戶問你公司 200 頁的產品手冊裡有沒有保固條款，你需要快速找到原文並引用回答。該用哪一種 AI 能力？
questions.textEn: [Hallucination Info Beast] Customer asks if there is a warranty clause in a 200-page manual, you need to quote the exact text. Which AI capability?
questions.prompt: 提示：亂猜有營運風險，必須要有憑有據地溯源。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Guessing has business risk; must have traceable evidence.
choices: A. 報告/信件草稿
B. 引用回答 (RAG)
C. 多語翻譯
D. 無源回答
choicesEn: A. Report/Email Draft
B. Cited Answers (RAG)
C. Multilingual Translation
D. Unsourced Answer
questions.explanation: RAG（檢索增強生成）技術能強制 AI 基於檢索到的企業內部文件生成答案，並標示資料來源，杜絕幻覺以確保商業回覆的可信度。
questions.explanationEn: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) forces AI to generate answers based on retrieved enterprise documents with citations.

questions.text: 【純文字防禦獸】行銷要你在 3 天內生出 10 張產品宣傳圖、30 秒影片廣告，還要配音。靠純文字打不出這場仗，該用哪種 AI 能力？
questions.textEn: [Plain Text Defense Beast] Marketing needs 10 promo images, 30s video ad, and voiceover in 3 days. Text alone won't win this battle. Which AI capability?
questions.prompt: 提示：需要同時處理圖、影、音的需求。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Requires handling image, video, and audio demands simultaneously.
choices: A. 結構化摘要
B. 問答對話
C. 純文字輸出
D. 綜合運用生成圖像、影片與聲音能力
choicesEn: A. Structured Summary
B. Q&A Chat
C. Plain Text Output
D. Multimodal Generation (Image/Video/Audio)
questions.explanation: 多模態 AI (Multimodal AI) 能跨越單一資料型態的限制，同時支援文生圖、文生影片與語音生成，一人即可抵上整個製作團隊。
questions.explanationEn: Multimodal AI breaks single data format limits, supporting text-to-image, text-to-video, and voice generation.

questions.text: 【數據竊影獸】各部門開始自求快：有人把客戶報價單直貼免費 AI，有人私自掛全自動 Agent 撈檔。要確保資安，哪種才是安全合規的做法？
questions.textEn: [Data Shadow Beast] Departments paste quotes into free AI or run unapproved Agents. To ensure security compliance, which is the right approach?
questions.prompt: 提示：方便與安全每天在拉扯，必須避免機密外洩的紅線行為。
questions.promptEn: Hint: Convenience vs Security; red line leaks must be prevented.
choices: A. 直接貼機密問 AI
B. 走正規流程建 RAG 並將資料去識別化
C. 機密灌進公有雲 API
D. 掛全自動 Agent 撈檔
choicesEn: A. Paste confidential data directly to free AI
B. Standard RAG architecture with data anonymization
C. Feed confidential data into public cloud API
D. Run unapproved Agent to fetch files
questions.explanation: 防止影子 IT 與資料外洩的防禦鐵則，是將資料透過標準化的 RAG 架構送出，並搭配去識別化處理，從源頭阻斷機敏外洩風險。
questions.explanationEn: Standardized RAG with data anonymization is the golden rule against shadow IT and data leaks.
